_notes: This is the shape the agent writes after scraping the product list; reconcile.py only reads it.
`total` is optional, but when present it is checked against len(items) - a missed page becomes a fake MISSING row, and a fake MISSING row is how a duplicate listing gets created.
`board` may sit on the wrapper (whole file) or on each row; a row without one inherits the file value, then --board.
`status` may be the page's own wording - 待审核/销售中/已驳回/回收站 and on-sale/pending-review/rejected all map; anything unrecognised is reported instead of guessed.
`createdAt` is optional: when the id starts SPU + 14 digits, the creation time is read from it.
A row may carry a bare `price` instead of specs (single-spec products); reconcile wraps it into one spec row.
